paper_title: Inhomogeneous Energy Injection in the 21-cm Power Spectrum: Sensitivity to Dark Matter Decay
suggested_experiment_name: DM21cm / HERA 21-cm power spectrum projected limit (chi->gamma gamma)
coupling_convention: DM decay lifetime tau^95 in seconds (projected 95th percentile lower limit). NOT a coupling constant.
notes: This paper forecasts HERA 21-cm power spectrum sensitivity to decaying dark matter, expressed as projected 95th-percentile lower limits on the DM lifetime (tau ~ up to 1e28 s) versus DM mass for decays to photons and to e+e- pairs. The constrained quantity is a DM decay lifetime/rate, which does not correspond to any of the listed axion/dark-photon/scalar coupling types.
